method: Read existing raw bytes; SHA256 direct; exact JSON integer/string metadata parsing; no numeric solver, model construction, reserialization or new canonical encoder. Populations/string lengths may feed only the separately reviewed descriptor contract.

entries.descriptor_basis: existing bytes and exact array/string metadata; no solver, graph/RCM/model builder or generated expectation
entries.model_sha256_semantics: SHA256 of actual UTF-8 file bytes (producer dumps(adapted)+newline, consumer read_to_string.as_bytes); equality verified without reserialization
entries.k4src_sha256_semantics: Separate canonical PrimitiveSource::encoding digest, not raw JSON. Manifest expected value retained; historical consumer witness bound below, no fresh builder/encoding run.

descriptor.graph_counts: B/b/z/h and histograms not computed; no graph/RCM pass performed
descriptor.source_capacity: Lengths/populations only; no measured/requested heap capacity or E_max conclusion
